conventions_added: guard_log.jsonl in the cache dir (loader guard events)
census artifacts at repo root: census.json, DATA_CENSUS.md, GAP_REPORT.md, SPOT_CHECK.md
header.note_hash_scope: sha256 covers whole cache files as of this census; rows/first/last describe the in-scope slice (>= LIT floor, < right edge)
header.storage_convention: Phase 1 parquet cache: klines/{SYMBOL}_{interval}.parquet (open_time ms UTC + OHLCV float64), funding/{SYMBOL}.parquet (funding_time ms UTC + funding_rate). Cache lives outside the repo (NAIAD_CACHE_DIR).
header.value_read_policy: census scans read only open_time / funding_time columns and raw bytes for SHA256; no OHLCV value is materialized (I3)
